fact: In its September 2026 quarterly bulletin the ASIN said the Code du numérique and data-protection rules are the legal base in force and that specific AI governance, liability and compliance rules are now indispensable; it names no legal vehicle, supervisory authority or timetable.
title: Régulation de l'IA au Bénin : l'ASIN appelle à des règles spécifiques de gouvernance et de conformité
